The owner's link · 400 days
everything: the whole walk-through,
review, the log, people, links,
delete the home

A person's link · 400 days
the accepted jobs, each with its own clip
and still · prove as themselves, ask ·
no transcripts, no review, no log

A sticker · 5 years
that one job, its clip and its still,
nothing else

Every request is checked · scope.py
signature · age · role · version ·
which jobs and which media it may open

A job's own clip, cut by code from the video
